name: Kick a Chat Member
description: Use this method to kick a user from a group, a supergroup or channel. [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#banchatmember) for more information

configurable_props.name: chatId
configurable_props.label: Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g. `1035597319`) or username of the target public chat (in the format `@channelusername` or `@supergroupusername`). For example, if the group's public link is `t.me/mygroup`, the username is `@mygroup`.

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier of the target user.

configurable_props.name: until_date
configurable_props.label: Until Date
configurable_props.description: Enter the date when the user will be unbanned, in [unix time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time) (e.g. `1567780450`).
